title: Run versioned checks against immutable snapshots and record attributable evidence
goal: Give AcceptanceAuthority executable evidence tied to the check version, criterion, candidate snapshot and actual environment instead of a loose post-invocation check.
scope: Implement register_check, run and evidence for visible/user checks with CheckAuthor, Independence, needs and version; support Command(program,args,inputs) and ExactBytes(path,digest). Record Baseline/Candidate/Control CheckRun roles, output/environment digests and Pass/Fail/Error(ErrorClass).

Build ProcessRunner with explicit Command executable/arguments/inputs and ExactBytes execution, bounded process lifecycle, verifier/input protection, retained stdout/stderr and environment identity. Run against the requested immutable Snapshot rather than the changing live workspace. The adapter returns observations; AcceptanceAuthority validates and commits them.

Create attributed Evidence with criterion/result, class, independence, run references, Discrimination and Supports/Contradicts. Validate applicability against current result/snapshot, criterion/check versions and environment before downstream use; the same applicability semantics feed A7, A8 and ClaimAuditor. Distinguish StaticRead/Inspection from Executed; record Review Approve/Reject/NeedsEvidence and Blocking/Advisory findings without acceptance authority.
acceptance: Through AcceptanceAuthority, a real command and exact-byte check run on before/after snapshots, retaining reproducible output and environment references. A deliberately incorrect artifact yields Fail while a missing executable or broken environment yields Error.
Changing the live workspace after result submission cannot change the checked snapshot. Evidence from another candidate, criterion or check version cannot support the current result.
ProcessRunner and a materially different CheckRunner implementation are exercised through the same consumer; an adapter-returned approval cannot register trusted independence or accept a result.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.2 (Check), 3.6 (CheckRun, Evidence, Review), 4 (AcceptanceAuthority), 5.1 (CheckRunner), A6/A7/A11. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-domain/src/verification.rs, crates/ymp-kernel/src/acceptance.rs and crates/ymp-runtime/src/checks/process.rs. W1-0008 supplies real ResultVersions, W1-0005/0016 exact snapshot content, and W1-0017 attributable execution/limits. Build all checking/evidence behavior in this iteration.

Command is the model’s explicit program/args/inputs contract. Do not substitute an unversioned shell string or a loose invocation-success label. W2 owns independent hidden design, Property/BrowserScenario/ExternalQuery, ContainerRunner and mutation.

Applicable criterion/result/check/environment bindings and source independence are kernel validation, shared by A7, A8 and ClaimAuditor. Cross-version evidence and an adapter-returned verdict cannot authorize acceptance.
